title: going to (plan)
explain_tr: **be going to + V1** önceden **planlanmış** gelecek eylemleri anlatır: *I'**m going to visit** my aunt next week.* (Plan yaptım, karar verilmiş.)
Ayrıca şu anki **kanıta** dayanan tahmin için: *Look at those clouds! It'**s going to rain**.*

Kalıp: **am / is / are + going to + V1**. En sık hata **be**'yi düşürmek: *I going to buy* ✗ → *I **am** going to buy* ✓. İkinci hata **to**'yu unutmak ya da -ing eklemek: *going buy* ✗, *going to buying* ✗.
Olumsuz: *She **isn't going to** come.* Soru: ***Are** you **going to** study tonight?*
Günlük konuşmada *going to* çoğu zaman **gonna** gibi duyulur; ama **yazıda going to** kullan.
explain_en: be going to + base verb: plans and intentions, and predictions based on present evidence. Don't drop am/is/are.

pairs.wrong: I going to visit my grandparents.
pairs.right: I am going to visit my grandparents.

pairs.wrong: She is going buy a car.
pairs.right: She is going to buy a car.

pairs.wrong: We are going to watching a film.
pairs.right: We are going to watch a film.

pairs.wrong: Look at the sky! It will rain.
pairs.right: Look at the sky! It's going to rain.
